Authorities opened a criminal case against him on suspicion of fraud and embezzlement, making him the first sitting governor to face criminal proceedings since the war began. Chibis took charge of the Murmansk region in 2019 and was reelected in 2024. Over the past several months, law enforcement has repeatedly opened criminal investigations into key members of his team. data.title: Meduza: Estonia is closing one of the last major land routes between Europe and Russia. Here’s what the drivers and passengers who depend on it have to say.
data.summary: Starting December 1, Estonia will close all five of its border crossings with Russia for at least six months. The crossings were used by many Russian emigres and tourists, as well as residents of the Baltic states and Finland who travel to Russia to see family or for work. Over the past few years, an entire industry has grown up around these crossings, with numerous firms and private drivers taking passengers to the checkpoints on both the Estonian and Russian sides. The independent journalist cooperative Bereg spoke with drivers and their clients about how the route through Estonia into Russia worked and what they plan to do once the border closes. Meduza is publishing the piece in full.
